{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Nathaniel Rateliff & The Night Sweats; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy soul sound interests me, but I would prioritize familiar blues artists this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent interest in Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels; I would choose this.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Nothing Has Changed; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and roots rock than a Bowie retrospective right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: After Memphis, I would choose another Boz Scaggs album for its soulful blues feel.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Tom Petty connects with my interest in Benmont Tench's You Should Be So Lucky, but I would leave this for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A vocal pop album is less appealing than guitar-led blues for my current listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Purple Album; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavier hard rock direction is not what I feel like listening to now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Led Zeppelin III Deluxe Edition; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its acoustic and blues elements appeal to me, but I would pass on the deluxe revisit this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less compelling to me right now than blues songs and vocals.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: On Air - Live At The BBC Volume 2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Beatles' early rock and rhythm-and-blues material appeals, but archival performances are a lower priority today."}
